Four is also the second square number after one. A small minority of people have four fingers on each hand and four toes on each foot.[source?] Four squared is 16, and four doubled is 8. In geometry, quadrilaterals or tetragons are a kind of shapes called polygons have four sides and vertices, to which squares are quadrilaterals with sides of same length and vertices of the same wideness.
